selector.rationale: Bilateral osteolysis of the mastoids, semicircular canals, and a separate osteolytic lesion in the parietal bone are more indicative of Langerhans cell histiocytosis, which can cause such widespread bone lesions.

rejected.label: Cholesteatoma
rejected.why: While cholesteatoma could explain some of the otologic findings, it does not typically cause the widespread osteolytic lesions seen in this patient.
